title: Brush: a stroke that crosses itself paints a HOLE at the crossing (Flash 8 self-unions); sharp corners thin/notch the ribbon
description:
FIXED via stamp-union brush ribbon. buildBrushRibbon() added to @flash/core engine/planar/brushpaint.ts: emits a nib disk per sample + a bridging capsule quad per segment (mirrors eraser buildEraserStamp), each stamp loop carrying its OWN distinct Fill object so buildArrangementFromShapes fill sampling (task 1425 grouping) resolves them as last-covering-wins UNION, not even-odd. StageArea.brushPointsToShape now delegates (keeps pressure/tilt half-width calc). pointInShapeFill in brushpaint.ts changed even-odd->union so non-Normal paint modes keep overlaps. Legacy engine/brushtool.ts addBrushStroke + its test deleted (unused product path). build.ts NOT touched.

REPROS (packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/brush-ribbon.test.ts, 10 tests): (1) contrast: naive single-outline ribbon holes at crossing (60,50) filled=false; (2) stamp-union: crossing (60,50) filled=true; (3) singly-covered still filled; (4) genuine-outside empty; (5) hairpin turn+overlap no null-fill notch; (6) L-elbow corner filled to full nib radius (no cos(theta/2) thinning); (7) degenerate/single-dab/square/distinct-Fill.

VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build exit 0. @flash/core test 356 files, 5818 pass / 2 skip. @flash/authoring-ui 115 files, 1299 pass (drawingTools brush block rewritten for union geometry). Docs: docs/04-toolbox.md brush ribbon bullet added.
